overview:
TX-37 covers much of Austin and is one of the most Democratic-leaning districts in Texas, with a partisan lean of roughly 30 points. Incumbent Greg Casar is seeking re-election and has raised about $1.4 million, holding more than half a million dollars on hand. Republican Lauren Peña has raised about $132,000 and reports only around $4,500 in cash, with no recorded outside spending on either side.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, but prediction markets put Casar's chances at roughly 98 percent. Given the district's lopsided fundamentals and the challenger's limited financial footprint, the seat is rated Safe Democratic. The residual uncertainty mainly reflects turnout in a low-profile contest rather than any realistic prospect of an upset.
